title: Three separate holds each contain a hermit NPC with near word-for-word identical dialogue and interaction structure — same opening ('doesn't look up first. Looks up eventually, and takes your measure quick'), same line ('Everyone wants something, coming this far out. What's yours?'), same three skill-check options, same 'parting gift by the door' closer — differing only in name (Maud / Fenwick / Hesk) and the flavor of the reward item.
where: Thornwold's Black Thorn Stand (old Maud), Kingswood's Fenwick's Clamp (old Fenwick), Wardmoor's Peat-Cutter's Hut (old Hesk)
